date_note: The page gives no earlier day than its own publication day, 27 November 2026; the day of the tampering is not stated.
exec: Tgcom24 reports hackers tampered with a refrigerator at a Slovenian cured-meat company; staff noticed before the contents warmed.
plain: Tgcom24 reports that hackers tampered with a refrigerator holding cured meats at a company in Slovenia. Staff who went to repair it found a message with a photo of Matteo Salvini.

sources.name: Tgcom24: Hacker manomettono frigo salumi: ringraziate zio Matteo

summary: Tgcom24 reports that hackers tampered with a refrigerator holding cured meats at a company in Slovenia. According to the report, staff who tried to repair the system found a message with a photo of Matteo Salvini. The company is not named and the page quotes no official statement.
title: Hackers reportedly tamper with cured-meat refrigerator at a Slovenian company

validation.note: Only Tgcom24 was read; Leggo, Europa Today and Corriere Adriatico returned 403/418 and could not be read. No official statement read.
